description: Post-AQ baseline. Wave 1-3 fully landed (self-hosting closure deferred per Phase 1.2 fallback). Wave 4 partial: Vec sizing landed; CSS L4 routing + key dispatch hash reverted (regression on var(--x)). Wave 5 follow-up: BBNF_CSP_REPORT instrumentation always emits per component.

bbnf_workspace.diff_vs_post_ap: Net +15 passing vs. pre-AQ master (which had 45 failures). 30 remaining failures are pre-existing on master and span CSS tape-parity goldens, closure pipeline tests, gorgeous formatter dumps, lsp analyze cycle/alias detection, and recover directive parses. None regressed by the AQ tranche.

delta_vs_post_ap.summary: Throughput essentially unchanged across the board. JSON twitter shows the largest dip (-4%), within run-to-run noise. The AQ tranche is performance-neutral; gains come from architectural cleanup (PayloadKind delete, TypeDesc integer suite, structural dispatch removal) rather than raw speed, and from leaving headroom for future passes (aggregate payloads, key dispatch hash) that need follow-up to ship safely.

phases: AQ.1 (self-hosting closure — partial: regen blocked by sub-variant compound coupling, span-text fallback restored)
AQ.3 (RegexClass deoverfit — 5 nominal variants → parameterized structural)
AQ.4 (scanner deoverfit — JSON/CSS-prefixed names removed; STRUCTURAL_PUNCTS derived from grammar)
AQ.6.A (PayloadKind delete + TypeDesc full integer suite)
AQ.6.B+C+D (aggregate payload layout planner + Alt typed enum view + rename cleanup)
AQ.7 + AQ.8.1 (REVERTED — CSS regression on var(--x))
AQ.9.1 + AQ.9.6 bench sweep + roundtrip freeze
CSS L4 bench regression triage (resolved — earlier failure was a stale parse-that state, all three datasets pass at master)

deferred_work: Bootstrap regen without span-text fallback (Phase 1.2): requires deeper architectural change to handle sub-variant compounds vs. typed view accessors.

CSS L4 identifier kernel routing (AQ.7.2): scan_ident does not handle CSS escape sequences — classifier must reject patterns that mix identifier shape with escape branches before kernel routing is safe.
Length-bucketed perfect hash for key dispatch (AQ.7.3): the worktree implementation regressed CSS L4; needs distinct test coverage for hash collision behavior.
TLS-recycled scratch (AQ.8.3): optional codegen flag — deferred.
NEON simd_str2int (AQ.8.4): current SWAR 8-digit chunks already fast — low ROI.
AQ.9.2 samply diff: deferred to a focused profiling pass.
AQ.9.4 cost model grid sweep: deferred.
AQ.9.5 global CSP solve: deferred (per-component CSP solve is sufficient at current grammar scale).

post_aq_status.code_quality: Codebase has shed 5 nominal RegexClass variants (JsonString/JsonNumber/CssIdent/CssQuotedString/WsBlockComment), 7 sp_*/sp_* SpanParser constructors, ~514 LOC of structural dispatch infrastructure, the PayloadKind enum, and consolidated 5 IR-walking primitives into a shared inspect module. TypeDesc carries the full integer suite (I8/I16/U16/I32/I64/U64) and the codegen consumes it directly via is_scalar_payload + payload_size_bytes helpers. Aggregate payload layout planner + Alt typed enum view codegen are wired but lie dormant until rules with payload-eligible Tuple types appear.
post_aq_status.test_health: 30 failing tests vs. 45 pre-existing on master pre-AQ — net +15 passing. Failures are pre-existing infrastructure issues (CSS data fixtures, gorgeous formatter goldens, recover directive edge cases) unrelated to this tranche.
post_aq_status.self_hosting: generated.rs still hand-maintained. Bootstrap regen path produces a divergent generated.rs because the codegen inlines single-use sub-rules even under preserve_identity. Resolution requires the deeper architectural change for sub-variant compound layout vs. typed view accessor dispatch.
